title: Impartiality.
bodyText: If a trust has two or more beneficiaries, the trustee shall act impartially in investing, managing, and distributing the trust property, giving due regard to the beneficiaries' respective interests.
bodyHtml: [§554D-803]  Impartiality.  If a trust has two or more beneficiaries, the trustee shall act impartially in investing, managing, and distributing the trust property, giving due regard to the beneficiaries' respective interests. [L 2021, c 32, pt of §2]
